profile.summary: St. Louis-based consultant interested in all things IT. Background in multiple industries with a focus on software solutions and Agile methodologies. Prioritizes communication, delivery, performance, and quality. Always looking to learn more and broaden my horizons, be that another language, paradigm, or methodology.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Worked withing payment acceptance space of a national US-based home improvement retailer based in Atlanta. Joined the team to develop a new line-of-credit tender for Pro customers in an existing internal-facing UI that was supported by a Go backend. Stayed on after the successful launch of that tender to develop a greenfield UI for refunds, and then later to support the addition of another customer wallet tender to the existing UI. Also supported other team-owned UIs and their respective backend flows.

Key accomplishments:
- Was the primary developer on the Pro line of credit tender UI for the team. The new tender achieved $250 million in market capture in the first year it was launched, with projected revenue gains exceeding $1 billion in subsequent years during initial project analysis. Responsibilities were full-stack, and included working closely with UX colleagues and QA team, as well as creating automated UI tests and assisting teammates knowledge transfer as other developers joined the effort.
- Extended internal Prometheus metrics to include outbound HTTP traffic, building out corresponding Grafana dashboards to visualize the new data.
- Advised on Go questions across multiple teams on topics ranging from language basics, idioms, concurrency, unit testing, application design, and helping teams approach new features.
- Found a production issue that was silently crashing Go application in concurrent code. Refactored the offending code, designed a package to provide resilience, and then gave a demonstration of the issue and code to multiple teams to raise awareness.
- Created design for application state in the new Refund UI, based in Typescript using the React Context API. Designed supporting utilities for interacting with state to ensure efficient storage and data access.
- Extended existing UI to add support for new customer wallet tender, building out supporting application state, business logic, and service calls to the UI and backend.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Worked withing payment authorization space of a national US-based home improvement retailer based in Atlanta. Joined to help team migrated legacy Java applications to new Go microservices. Provided support for developers learning the language, developed some of the Go applications and worked on greenfield Go applications. Also performed updates, KTLO, and production support for the legacy Java applications.

positions.title: Application Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St. Louis City County, Missouri, United States
positions.description: Built EDI 278 intake applications for Centene's UM systems. Designed database models to capture business rules for project to automate manual data-cleaning process that existed within the claims process. Built transformation engine to apply those business rules to incoming authorizations from the 278 intake channel. Lead team of contractors to oversee work on a CRUD API that stored and processed the business rules, supporting their coding efforts, answering design questions, and creating documentation and design diagrams for the new process.

positions.title: Application Software Developer
positions.description:
Go developer working on backend RESTful APIs in the new TruCare Cloud platform, within the UM space. Responsible for the development and/or creation of multiple microservice APIs. Experience with RESTful principles and design, and also GraphQL. 

Owned applications that form the primary intake gateway for the TruCare Cloud platform, from which all internal rules systems are run against incoming requests for medical services (authorizations). Developed new API intake systems to aid in new integrations with other states/health plans. Team also owns other backend data services/CRUDs.

Experience working with Kafka, persistence layers/CRUD APIs leveraging MongoDB, and creating internal Go libraries for team/org use around common use cases. Developed APIs that interoperate with an EDI system processing 278 authorizations, converting from inbound XML CBO to internal JSON models. 

Heavy focus on unit-testing and encouraging unit-test adoption among colleagues. Deployment infrastructure is based on Docker and Kubernetes.

Experience load-testing, analyzing performance, adding concurrency to reduce overall processing time, and refactoring and/or changing API call patterns to optimize hot path processing flows.

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description: LaunchCode apprentice working at Centene, developing in Golang working on an ETL micro-service pipeline. Work with RESTful applications that transform data coming from a NoSQL database, which are then sent to other internal APIs. Utilize unit tests to validate behavior and correctness of new features. Projects are deployed utilizing a CI/CD pipeline, Docker and Kubernetes. Collaborate in an Agile workflow with colleague and product owners to ensure quick delivery to end users.

positions.title: Apprentice
positions.description:
Currently working as a LaunchCode apprentice developing internal web applications on Express Scripts' Security Engineering team. I've completed internal training for secure coding best practices with the goal of being able to conduct code security reviews, as well as implementing best practices in my own process.

I'm taking this opportunity to immerse myself in cyber security, automated testing/TDD, DevOps/DevSecOps methodologies, Agile development, and, of course furthering my programming knowledge all the while.

positions.title: Property Manager
positions.description: Started an executive assistant, acquired a real estate license and took over many internal office administrative responsibilities, marketing work, and finally property management and bookkeeping tasks. Worked directly with the broker/owner, city inspectors, clients (property owners) and customers (tenants).

positions.title: Freelance Writer
positions.description: Produced hundreds of articles over the years about a wide variety of topics, ranging form charities, hospitals, businesses and government. Final copy may have been a sentence, a few paragraphs, or long-form writeups with historical research. Worked closely with community leaders to plan content, interviewed hundreds of people as a part of the normal course research for a given article. Focused on community-driven print publications, such as newspapers and quarterly magazines, that were circulated with newspapers or directly to clients.
